title: Insta360 has given its flagship 4K webcams an icy cool glow-up — now available in arctic white
excerpt: New look, same old AI 4K brilliance.
content_html:
Credit: Insta360

$159.99 at Amazon

Credit: Insta360

$199.99 at Amazon

If you’re looking to upgrade your workstation with a new look while also getting the best possible performance from your tech, check out the new-look models from Insta360’s flagship AI 4K webcam series. 

The Insta360 Link 2 Pro and Link 2C Pro are now available in arctic white, designed specifically for modern-looking workspaces and creator setups. The Insta360 Link 2 Pro is now available at Amazon for $199.99, and the Link 2C Pro is priced at $159.99.

These cameras may have a new look, but Insta360, which is the world’s best-selling 360 camera brand, has approached the camera technology with a “if ain’t broke, don’t fix it” kinda attitude, meaning the Link 2 Pro and Link 2C Pro have retained all the features and specs while offering upgrades via the software ecosystem.

Both versions of the Link 2 Pro are built around a large 1/1.3-inch sensor that’s built to capture natural, highly-detailed, professional-level 4K video wherever you are — it’s particularly good if you create content or take video meetings on-the-go, and you can’t always be sure of the lighting. These cameras are built to deliver strong low-light performance.

They also boast AI-assisted features, including AI-powered noise reduction. The Link 2 Pro also has AI tracking that follows you as you move, always keeping you framed to maintain a balanced, professional perspective as you talk or present. The Link 2C Pro, meanwhile, has a fixed-body design but also features Auto Framing for both solo and group presentations.

You can also access various creative tools through Insta360’s software ecosystem, which continues to evolve. Available tools include virtual backgrounds, a smart whiteboard, an all-new teleprompter for notes and talking points, and custom overlays that can add text, images, and video to your presentations and meetings. And the Insta360 InSight tool uses AI to transcribe and write-up summaries of meetings.

Get the Insta360 Link 2 Pro for $199.99 and Insta360 Link 2C Pro for $159.99 at Amazon now.
